title: Smart Retopo result
description: Result of one Smart Retopo run. Produced by RetopoResult.to_dict() (smart_retopo/core/settings.py). The operator stores it as JSON in window_manager['smart_retopo_last_result']; cli.py prints it after 'SMART_RETOPO_RESULT: ' with the extra keys ok/output/error. This is a public interface for Nodey and MCP: removing or renaming a key is a breaking change.

object_name.description: Name of the new low-poly object, '<base>_retopo'. With a provided low-poly this is a copy of it; the provided object is not modified.

material_name.description: Name of the new baked material, '<base>_baked'.

source_objects.description: Names of the input objects that were combined.

source_faces.description: Face count of the combined, evaluated input.

result_faces.description: Face count of the low-poly: after QuadriFlow (approximately target_faces), or of the provided low-poly.

used_voxel_remesh.description: True if a voxel remesh ran before QuadriFlow (pre-pass or fallback). Always false with a provided low-poly.

low_poly_object.description: Name of the provided low-poly object (settings.low_poly_object), or '' when QuadriFlow generated it.

uvs_generated.description: True if new UVs were unwrapped (uv_mode GENERATE); false if the provided low-poly's existing UV map was used (uv_mode EXISTING).

images.description: Baked map name to file path, or '<packed>' when output_dir was empty.

timings.description: Seconds per stage. Keys present depend on how far the run got.

ok.description: CLI only: false if the run failed (the process also exits 1).

output.description: CLI only: absolute path of the exported mesh.

error.description: CLI only, when ok is false: the error message. The other keys are absent in that case.
